"""Second random job generator: extreme values, deep slots, many prefixes."""
import random


def gen_job(rng):
    nf = rng.randint(1, 4)
    slots = rng.randint(1, 4)
    types = ['time', 'size', 'count', 'id', 'flag']
    fields = []
    for i in range(nf):
        t = types[rng.randrange(len(types))]
        if t in ('id', 'flag'):
            size = rng.randint(1, 3)
            domain = sorted(rng.sample([0, 1, 2, 3, 10, 11, 100, 1000000], size))
        else:
            size = rng.randint(1, 4)
            hi = rng.choice([3, 20, 1000, 1000000])
            domain = sorted(rng.sample(range(0, hi + 1), size))
        fields.append({'name': 'f%d' % i, 'type': t, 'domain': domain})
    numeric = [f for f in fields if f['type'] in ('time', 'size', 'count')]
    ops = ['eq', 'ne', 'lt', 'le', 'gt', 'ge']
    preds = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 7)):
        kind = rng.choice(['cmp', 'cmp', 'any', 'all'])
        if kind == 'cmp':
            shape = rng.randint(0, 3)
            pool = numeric or fields
            f = rng.choice(pool)
            if shape == 0 or not numeric:
                left = {'ref': [rng.randrange(slots), f['name']]}
            elif shape == 1:
                g = rng.choice(numeric)
                left = {'scale': rng.choice([0, 1, 2, 7, 65535]), 'ref': [rng.randrange(slots), g['name']]}
            else:
                g = rng.choice(numeric)
                refs = list({[s, g['name']] for s in range(slots)})[:slots]
                rng.shuffle(refs)
                left = {'sum': refs[:rng.randint(1, len(refs))]}
            def reftype(term):
                name = term['ref'][1] if 'ref' in term else term['sum'][0][1]
                return next(x['type'] for x in fields if x['name'] == name)
            t = reftype(left)
            op = rng.choice(ops if t in ('time', 'size', 'count') else ['eq', 'ne'])
            right = {'const': rng.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 10, 11, 999, 1000000]), 'type': t}
            preds.append({'kind': 'cmp', 'left': left, 'op': op, 'right': right})
        else:
            f = rng.choice(fields)
            op = rng.choice(ops if f['type'] in ('time', 'size', 'count') else ['eq', 'ne'])
            preds.append({'kind': kind, 'field': f['name'], 'op': op,
                          'value': rng.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 10, 11, 100, 1000000])})
    n_train = rng.randint(1, 8)
    train = [[[rng.choice(f['domain']) for f in fields] for _ in range(slots)] for _ in range(n_train)]
    width = rng.randint(1, 3)
    approved = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 5)):
        size = rng.randint(1, width)
        approved.append(sorted(rng.sample(range(len(preds)), min(size, len(preds)))))
    queries = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 6)):
        target = [rng.randrange(slots), rng.choice(fields)['name']]
        fixed = []
        used = {tuple(target)}
        for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 3)):
            cell = [rng.randrange(slots), rng.choice(fields)['name']]
            if tuple(cell) in used:
                continue
            used.add(tuple(cell))
            domain = next(f['domain'] for f in fields if f['name'] == cell[1])
            fixed.append({'ref': cell, 'value': rng.choice(domain)})
        length = rng.randint(0, 7)
        prefix = ''.join(rng.choice('0123456789') for _ in range(length))
        if rng.random() < 0.4:
            prefix = ''
        queries.append({'fixed': fixed, 'target': target, 'prefix': prefix})
    return {'fields': fields, 'slots': slots, 'predicates': preds, 'width': width,
            'train': train, 'approved': approved, 'queries': queries}
PY
